hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '\.go"' ; then path=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oE '"file_path"\s*:\s*"[^"]+\.go"' | grep -oE '"[^"]+\.go"' | tr -d '"') ; if [ -n "$path" ] && [ -f "$path" ] ; then gofmt -w "$path" 2>/dev/null || true ; fi ; fi
hooks.description: Auto-gofmt any Go file after edit

hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'migrations/[0-9]+_.*\.up\.sql' ; then echo 'WARNING: editing a migration file. If this migration has already been applied, add a NEW migration instead. Check migrations/.applied.txt or schema_migrations table.' >&2 ; fi

cmd=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oE '"command"\s*:\s*"[^"]*"' | head -1) ; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'rm -rf .*migrations' ; then echo 'BLOCKED: refuse to rm -rf migrations/' >&2 ; exit 2 ; fi ; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git push.*--force.*main' ; then echo 'BLOCKED: force-push to main' >&2 ; exit 2 ; fi
hooks.description: Block destructive ops on migrations/ and force-push to main
